# permission.json

<!-- generated by `letibot --config-reference --markdown permission.json`; do not edit -->

Location: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/letibot/permission.json, else ~/.config/letibot/permission.json; $LETIBOT_PERMISSION (JSON) is appended

what never asks: per tool, a pattern over its path or one simple bash command, to allow, deny or ask. The last matching rule wins; no match asks

Written by: the daemon: installs config/permission.json once when absent, and appends each "Always allow" (whole file re-serialised)

## `top level`

Patterns: * any run (including /), ? one character; a trailing ` *` makes the space optional. A bad entry fails the whole file.

| key | type | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$comment` | string | none | free text; ignored |
| `<tool>` | "allow" \| "deny" \| "ask" | ask | one action for every call of the tool (pattern *) |
| `<tool>.<pattern>` | "allow" \| "deny" \| "ask" | ask | action for calls matching the pattern; bash matches each simple command |
